theorem count_tail_windowG (hp : PolyDatum f B κ) {T T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 0 < T0) (S : Finset ℂ)
    (hS : S ⊆ zerosRectD f T) (hre : ∀ u ∈ S, 0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1) (him : ∀ u ∈ S, T0 < |u.im|)
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => ⌊(|u.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ = k), (multRectD f T u : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Z3g B T0 + 2 * c3g κ T0 * (k + 1) :=

note: Lean has no counterpart of Lemma 9.1.3 and no N(T,χ) integral; it counts zeros in 4.4-wide windows by Jensen's formula and sums a geometric series. Erratum: Lemma 9.1.3's proof sets f(y)g_χ(y) − ∫f′g_χ = 0.5∫f/T, but integration by parts gives 2f(y)g_χ(y) + 0.5∫f/T (0.98622 against 0.00101 for the book's f at y = 75), so the decreasing-f clause and hence (9.66) lack f(T₀)g_χ(T₀). (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_9_66.py`).
